title: Single stack servers have trouble connecting to dual stack servers

labels.name: X-Needs-Info
labels.description: This issue is blocked awaiting information from the reporter

body:
### Description

On a single stack (IPv4 only) server I see the following log:

```
2022-03-24 14:46:48,109 - synapse.http.federation.matrix_federation_agent - 364 - INFO - GET-197- Failed to connect to ungleich.ch:8448: No route to host: 101: Network is unreachable.
2022-03-24 14:46:48,110 - synapse.http.matrixfederationclient - 649 - INFO - GET-197- {GET-O-11} [ungleich.ch] Request failed: GET matrix://ungleich.ch/_matrix/federation/v1/query/profile?user_id=%40nico%3Aungleich.ch&field=displayname: NoRouteError('Network is unreachable')
2022-03-24 14:46:48,110 - synapse.http.server - 95 - INFO - GET-197- <XForwardedForRequest at 0x7f8f963477c0 method='GET' uri='/_matrix/client/r0/profile/%40nico%3Aungleich.ch' clientproto='HTTP/1.1' site='8008'> SynapseError: 502 - Failed to fetch profile

2022-03-24 14:46:50,788 - synapse.http.federation.matrix_federation_agent - 364 - INFO - GET-198- Failed to connect to ungleich.ch:8448: No route to host: 101: Network is unreachable.
2022-03-24 14:46:50,789 - synapse.http.matrixfederationclient - 649 - INFO - GET-198- {GET-O-12} [ungleich.ch] Request failed: GET matrix://ungleich.ch/_matrix/federation/v1/query/profile?user_id=%40nico%3Aungleich.ch&field=displayname: NoRouteError('Network is unreachable')
2022-03-24 14:46:50,789 - synapse.http.server - 95 - INFO - GET-198- <XForwardedForRequest at 0x7f8f963e8910 method='GET' uri='/_matrix/client/r0/profile/%40nico%3Aungleich.ch' clientproto='HTTP/1.1' site='8008'> SynapseError: 502 - Failed to fetch profile

```

### Steps to reproduce

* Setup a dual stack server (IPv6+IPv4)
* Ensure the homeserver's DNS domain has an AAAA and A entry
* Setup a single stack server (IPv4 only)
* Try to send a message / invite / ... to the dual stack server
* Depending on which protocol is first (?) resolved, you get a route error even though the server would be reachable

### Version information

* Synapse v1.54.0 from the docker image

- **Homeserver**: ungleich.ch as a destination, any source
